history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A young Asian man with short, dark hair smiles at the camera, wearing a black jacket and black cargo pants. He is sitting on a rocky, mountainous terrain, holding a sign with orange and yellow borders. The sign has red lettering that reads "RINJANI 3726 MDPL" and below that, "Atap Rinjani". Behind him, a breathtaking panoramic view unfolds. A large, turquoise crater lake is nestled within a volcanic caldera, surrounded by rugged, barren slopes dotted with patches of green vegetation. Wisps of white clouds drift across a vibrant blue sky, casting shadows on the landscape. The lighting suggests it's daytime, with bright sunlight illuminating the scene and creating distinct shadows on the rocks and the man. The overall mood is one of accomplishment and awe, capturing the beauty of a high-altitude natural landscape. The color palette is dominated by the blues of the sky and water, the earthy tones of the rocks, and the vivid green of the vegetation.
